generic_sampling_rules.int_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.int_fk: Copy an existing parent key value; allow NULL only if the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Positive integers sampled from a small range (1..1000); never NULL when NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.real_quantity: Positive reals with one decimal place sampled from a range consistent with the column statistics; never NULL when NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Short text values drawn from a small pool of distinct strings; near-variants (case/whitespace/punctuation) allowed when no constraint forbids it.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Values drawn from the explicit enum list for the column.
generic_sampling_rules.text_ranking: Strings of the form '<int> of <int>' with comma grouping optional; near-variants allowed.
generic_sampling_rules.year: Integers in a plausible year range (1900..2100).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, at least one NULL row per instance; NULL share follows the compact database share (0.0 in the shown sample, so a small share such as 5-10% is used). Nullable foreign-key columns must not be all-NULL: the non-NULL share must be at least 90%.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For numeric columns with listed boundary literals, include values at the literal and one step on each side (step = 0.1 for REAL, 1 for INT).
generic_sampling_rules.tie: For ORDER columns with listed tie ranks, include at least two rows sharing the value at that rank; the tie must be placed exactly at the requested rank, so the table must have at least that many rows.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate: For DISTINCT columns with a duplicate share target, include repeated values so the duplicate share falls in 20-50%.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values: About 30% of text values are fresh (not copied from the original pool) to exercise near-variant patterns.
